title: Information Security Engineer – DVA/DAST & Penetration Testing
description:
Information Security Engineer – DVA/DAST & Penetration Testing

**Location:** Noida  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Salary:** ₹30–32 LPA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Information Security Engineer** with strong hands-on experience in **Dynamic Vulnerability Assessment (DVA/DAST) and Penetration Testing**.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for web applications, APIs, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Identify, validate, and assess security vulnerabilities and eliminate false positives.
* Perform manual penetration testing and identify potential attack vectors.
* Provide remediation recommendations and validate fixes through retesting.
* Prepare detailed security assessment reports with risk ratings and recommendations.
* Work closely with development and operations teams to improve application security.

Required Skills

* 4–8 years of hands-on experience in DVA/DAST and penetration testing.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, and common attack vectors.
* Hands-on experience with **Burp Suite, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit**, or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of authentication, authorization, session management, cryptography, network security, and cloud security.
* Knowledge of SDLC and DevSecOps practices.
* Strong communication and report-writing skills.

**Relevant security certifications will be an added advantage.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at **hr@mithilasoftech.com**.

Pay: Up to ₹3,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
